listing.name: Galerians (Galerians Recompiled)
listing.summary: Upstream route: ReleaseZIP is a setup/bootstrapper, not a ready-made complete game. Galerians_Recompiled wizard selects disc1 then Generate&rebuild compiles locally; Windows can fetch portable tools, otherhosts require compiler tools. Upstream owns preparation. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream reports local generation/build and BIOS/FMV/title progress. Some blocks use interpreter fallback; complete three-disc playthrough Unknown. Generate and rebuild from disc on first setup; static compilation misses some blocks and falls back to interpreter. Keep incomplete playthrough claims separate from package availability. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux/macOS setup ZIPs. Windows may fetch tools; Linux/macOS need CMake, Ninja, Python and a compiler. Exact host architecture Unknown. Original data: Own all three Galerians USA discs: SLUS00986,SLUS01098,SLUS01099. Data-track MD5s217885a22fbb0f3092f8405ce42419ea,5bc6de661cb074cd5218ac0b9daecda2,992e16e5164febd23c8242ede1fc0d8c. Bundled OpenBIOS replaces retail BIOS. Setup generates/builds game code locally; some blocks fall back to interpreter. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
